reviews.title: Inexpensive frame does its job
reviews.review_text: I bought a bunch of these...in the neighborhood of 200 for certificates to present. Only a 3 were damaged. I picked these because I don't like to mess with the hateful prongs. The glass pops out, you put the certificate in and pop the glass back in. It did not take a great amount of time with two people working as a team. Don't put the little stand thing on it unless you plan on it being there forever or until you break it. We tried doing this with one of the damaged ones and once we got it in it does not move. For what they cost, it was a good value and served its purpose.
